basics.name: Paulo Gabriel Antunes
basics.label: Senior Front-End Developer
basics.summary: 20 years building and shipping web products for organizations around the world — most recently as a Senior Front-End Developer on enterprise platforms across government, nonprofit, and membership sectors. Hands-on specialty: web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508).

work.name: Freelancer
work.summary: Web development and digital strategy for my own clients, alongside agency and in-house roles. Contracts and invoices go through my Brazilian company.

work.name: Taoti Creative
work.summary: While at Taoti, worked on enterprise Drupal and WordPress sites for Taoti's clients, including The German Marshall Fund of the United States, International Women's Forum, APTA, and IAAPA. Led web accessibility auditing and remediation (WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508). Integrated AI tools into daily front-end workflows via Figma MCP integration.
highlights: Enterprise Drupal and WordPress development for government, nonprofit, and membership organizations
Web accessibility specialist: WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508 auditing and remediation
Component-based front-end with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Twig, Tailwind CSS
AI-assisted workflows: Figma MCP integration, AI-assisted debugging and QA
Authored build specifications and performed cross-team QA
